title: The Sawyer family
description: Read about the Sawyer family's daily routine and practise time expressions, articles and present-simple verbs. 阅读索耶一家的日常生活，并练习时间短语、冠词和一般现在时动词。
answer_note: The workbook key supplies answers for Practice A, B questions 2–5, and C. Practice B question 1 is a printed worked example. The grammar key supplies answers for Grammar I, II and III questions 2–10; Grammar III question 1 is a printed worked example. The before-reading answer has no supplied official key and is suggested. In Grammar I, × in the printed key means no article. Grammar III question 7 retains the printed key's I/We alternatives.

lesson.title: Listen then answer this question.
lesson.instruction: Listen then answer this question. 听录音，然后回答问题。
lesson.translation: 孩子们什么时候做功课？

questions.prompt: When do the children do their homework?
questions.answer: They always do their homework at night.

lines.text: The Sawyers live at 87 King Street.
lines.translation: 索耶一家住在国王街87号。

lines.text: In the morning, Mr. Sawyer goes to work and the children go to school.
lines.translation: 早上，索耶先生去上班，孩子们去上学。

lines.text: Their father takes them to school every day.
lines.translation: 父亲每天送孩子们去上学。

lines.text: Mrs. Sawyer stays at home every day.
lines.translation: 索耶夫人每天呆在家里。

lines.text: She always eats her lunch at noon.
In the afternoon, she usually sees her friends.
lines.translation: 下午，她总是会见她的朋友。

lines.text: In the evening, the children come home from school.
Mr. Sawyer comes home from work.
At night, the children always do their homework.
lines.translation: 晚上，孩子们总是做作业。

lines.text: Mr. Sawyer usually reads his newspaper,
but sometimes he and his wife watch television.
lines.translation: 但有时和他的妻子一起看电视。

items.title: 1 the Sawyers
items.text: the Sawyers 是指索耶一家。在英文中，姓氏后面加 s，前面加定冠词 the，用来指一家人，特别是丈夫和妻子。

items.title: 2 go to school
items.text: go to school，上学，请注意 school 前不带任何冠词。

items.title: 3 at noon
items.text: at noon 指“正午”，也叫 midday。请注意本课中表示时间的不同短语：in the morning/afternoon/evening, at noon/night。

items.title: 4 They arrive home early.
items.text: 在本句中 home 和 early 都是副词，下文中的 home 和 late 也是副词。

practice.title: A The Sawyer family
practice.instruction: Read this. Fill in the missing words. 阅读短文并填空。
practice.translation: 阅读短文，填入所缺的词。

questions.prompt: The Sawyers ______ at 87, King Street.
______ the morning Mr. Sawyer ______ to work and the children ______ to school.
Their father ______ them to ______ every day.
Mrs. Sawyer ______ at home every day and ______ the housework.
She always ______ her lunch at ______.
______ the afternoon she usually ______ her ______ and they ______ tea together.

practice.title: B Vocabulary
practice.instruction: Match the verbs on the left with words on the right. Ask questions about Mrs. Sawyer. Fill in the blanks in these questions with appropriate words. 将左右框中的词组成短语，针对索耶夫人提问；用合适的词填空。
practice.translation: 将左右框中的词组成短语，再完成关于索耶夫人的问题。
practice.context: Verbs: stay, drink, do, read, watch. Words: tea, television, at home, the housework, a newspaper. Phrases in the printed key: stay at home; drink tea; do the housework; read a newspaper; watch television.

questions.prompt: ______ every day?
______ with her friends in the afternoon?
______ in the morning?
______ in the evening?
______ in the evening with her husband?

practice.title: C Prepositions
practice.instruction: Fill in the correct prepositions – in, at, to or from. 用正确的介词填空：in、at、to 或 from。
practice.translation: 在每个空格填入正确的介词。

questions.prompt: He goes ______ work early and he comes home ______ work late.
She comes home ______ school at 3 o’clock ______ the afternoon.
______ the morning she does the housework and she eats lunch ______ noon.
It’s pleasant here. It rains ______ the morning and the sun shines ______ the afternoon.
My uncle stays ______ home in the day and goes to work ______ the evening.

grammar.title: I. Articles
grammar.instruction: Fill in the blanks with “the” where necessary. 在必要的空白处填上 the；不需要冠词时填 ×。
grammar.translation: 判断每个空格是否需要定冠词 the。

questions.prompt: Miss Tan goes to ______ work by car every day. She arrives at ______ office at eight in ______ morning, and she comes home late in ______ evening.
Mr. and Mrs. Smith usually stay at ______ home in ______ afternoon.
That new student is Austrian. He comes from ______ Austria.
They often come home late at ______ night.
What’s ______ climate like in your country? It’s interesting. It’s often cold in ______ North and windy in ______ East.
Do you often eat ______ lamb? No, I don’t. I don’t like ______ lamb. But I like ______ beef.
To tell you ______ truth, Mr. James doesn’t shave every day.
Our cat drinks ______ milk, but it doesn’t drink ______ water.
Can you give me a hammer, please? Which one? This small one? No, not ______ small one. ______ big one.
______ Sawyers usually watch ______ television every evening.

grammar.title: II. Tim’s Day
grammar.instruction: Fill in each blank with the correct form of the verb given. 用所给动词的正确形式填空。
grammar.translation: 阅读 Tim’s Day，按括号中的动词填空；每段的答案按空格顺序填写。

questions.prompt: Tim ______ (wake) up at eight o’clock in the morning, and ______ (get) up at half past eight. He ______ (wash) his face and hands and ______ (clean) his teeth. Then he ______ (go) downstairs for breakfast. He ______ (eat) two eggs and some bread and butter, and he ______ (drink) two or three cups of coffee.
questions.answer: wakes, gets, washes, cleans, goes, eats, drinks

questions.prompt: After breakfast he ______ (walk) to Mr. Scott’s house. He ______ (be) often late. He ______ (show) Mr. Scott his homework, and there ______ (be) often mistakes in it.

For lunch at noon, he usually ______ (eat) three pieces of steak and tomatoes or beans. After lunch he always ______ (drink) a cup of tea with sugar in it. He sometimes ______ (sit) in an armchair and ______ (read) a newspaper, and sometimes, but not often, he ______ (do) some work for Mr. Scott.
For supper in the evening, he ______ (eat) some slices of bread, butter, honey and cakes. Then he ______ (watch) television or ______ (talk) to friends.

grammar.title: III. Answer the questions
grammar.instruction: Answer the questions, using the cues given according to the example. 仿照例句，用所给的词回答下列问题。
grammar.translation: 根据括号中的提示，写出完整回答。

questions.prompt: Do you usually go to school by bus or by bike? (by bike)
questions.answer: I usually go to school by bike.

questions.prompt: Do your classmates often ask questions in class or after class? (after class)
questions.answer: They often ask questions after class.

questions.prompt: Are your teachers always busy or only sometimes? (always)
Does your father usually go to work early or late? (early)
questions.answer: He usually goes to work early.

questions.prompt: Does your friend watch television or do his homework in the evening? (do his homework)
questions.answer: He does his homework in the evening.

questions.prompt: Does your mother go to the shops every day or every week? (every day)
questions.answer: She goes to the shops every day.

questions.prompt: Do you often play basketball or football in the afternoon? (football)
questions.answer: I/We often play football in the afternoon.

questions.prompt: Does she usually go to school in the morning or in the afternoon? (in the morning)
questions.answer: She usually goes to school in the morning.

questions.prompt: Does Jane go to bed early or late every evening? (early)
questions.answer: She goes to bed early every evening.

questions.prompt: Do you always go out with friends or stay at home in the evening? (stay at home)
questions.answer: I always stay at home in the evening.
